encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; LF line endings; canonical compact sorted-key JSONL with final LF
evaluation_discipline: Use development queries only to choose any retrieval score cutoff.
Freeze the chosen configuration before first holdout execution.
Evaluate unchanged holdout once and preserve every case result.
If holdout informs repairs, disclose exposure and create a new independent holdout for any new claim.
hash_scope: All listed files are hashed over exact bytes; manifest.json is excluded to avoid self-reference.

label_contract.positive: one expected source; every other source forbidden
label_contract.scope: synthetic semantic relevance only; not human calibration, factual correctness, business decision or production quality
label_contract.unsupported: empty expected source set; all corpus sources forbidden

limits: Character length is an authoring constraint, not an actual tokenizer result.
Runtime must verify intended single-chunk publication and document/version/section/excerpt mapping.
Synthetic relevance judgements require no human expert validation claim.

provenance.author: AI agent, data-author role
provenance.material: New synthetic project-only demo knowledge and synthetic relevance labels
